answer: Treat each agent as a vertex in a payment graph and spread trust outward from a few audited seed agents, capped by the real value each edge has carried. A sybil farm can forge a thousand identities overnight, but by dawn they still share only the thin set of edges the operator paid for with honest counterparties, so their combined trust stays near one account's. To look like a thousand agents, the attacker must buy a thousand real, costly trading relationships.
